conclusions.text: All 16 exact components and all three contacts joined to the retained complete roster, routing rows and physical-comparison rows; six complete administrative source products were parsed.

The two Atlas-consumed simplified administrative products each overlap 12 of 16 family components; the same-commit full-resolution Lithuania product, current official Lithuania INSPIRE product, and Latvia official 2021 and 2026 products each overlap 15 of 16. These are source-footprint observations only.

Date-stamped authoritative land/water evidence and complete observation dates/accuracy were not obtained. Physical surface, authority, historical applicability, lineage and correction remain unresolved.
